message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: Liu purchased and sold "three-no" weight loss drugs (no production license, no food production license). He acted as a middleman, distributing counterfeit or unqualified drugs, selling large amount (value 13.84万元, plus earlier 20,000 bottles). The prosecution says "以不合格产品冒充合格产品，销售金额二十万元以上不满五十万元". This likely corresponds to "生产、销售假药罪" (manufacture and sale of counterfeit drugs) under Criminal Law Article 141? Actually Article 141 is "生产、销售假药罪". Also possibly "非法经营罪" (illegal business) but the main is "生产、销售假药罪". Also maybe "走私、贩卖、运输、制造、非法买卖危险化学品罪"? No. The facts involve no license, selling counterfeit drugs. So crime: "生产、销售假药罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪" if no license. But the law: Article 144 of Criminal Law: "非法经营罪" includes selling counterfeit goods? Actually illegal business includes selling counterfeit goods without license. However the prosecution specifically mentions "以不合格产品冒充合格产品，销售金额二十万元以上不满五十万元". That matches the sentencing range for "生产、销售假药罪" (selling counterfeit drugs) where the amount is 20k-50k yuan, punishable by fixed-term imprisonment. So we list that.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售假药罪<eoa>
